window.name: Location
window._note: ETP-5806 housekeeping: this artifact was a pipeline orphan (AD Window 121 'Location', ISACTIVE='N', no menu entry, never processed through decisions.json/push-to-neo — only a stale March-2026 contract.json + generated/ from an early test run). Migrated into the pipeline now because its NEO Headless API stays live and writable (create/update/delete enabled) regardless of menu visibility, and a live MCP probe found it accepted plain-text addressLine1/addressLine2 writes with none of ETP-5806's structured-address rules applied — the one address-writing surface the rest of the ticket missed. PUSH_TO_NEO was deliberately NOT run for this change: the live ETGO_SF_ENTITY row (Name='bpLocation') predates today's naming convention and was populated by hand outside this pipeline; re-running push-to-neo risks creating a duplicate/divergent entity rather than updating it in place. This decisions.json documents the intended curated shape (and is the source of truth for a future, carefully-verified push-to-neo migration) but the actual ETP-5806 behavior (mandatory Street/Number/City/Country, Address1/Address2 computed, streetName/buildingNumber/buildingName naming) is enforced by BpLocationHandler (com.etendoerp.go), independent of ETGO_SF_FIELD state.

addressLine1._note: ETP-5806: computed from streetName/buildingNumber/buildingName by BpLocationHandler, same algorithm (and same product decision: stricter than Classic) as ContactsLocationAddressHandler/WarehouseLocationHandler. Not yet pushed to NEO (ETGO_SF_FIELD.isreadonly stays 'N' live) — the handler enforces this by always overwriting the value server-side regardless of what a caller sends.

oBSEPAStreetName._note: ETP-5806 structured SEPA field, published as 'streetName' (see AddressVirtualSelectorPolicy#PUBLISHED_NAME_OVERRIDES and BpLocationHandler). Mandatory together with buildingNumber/cityName/country — enforced by BpLocationHandler, not by AD_Column.IsMandatory (still 'N' on EM_OBSEPA_StrtNm, so this 'required' flag is documentation only until a push-to-neo migration curates the live ETGO_SF_FIELD row).

oBSEPABuildingName._note: Published as 'buildingName'. Optional, matching every other ETP-5806 address surface.
